title: Feed A Crowd: Chickpea and Veg Salad
subtitle: Cook Once, Serve More!
description: Serve up more with our Feed A Crowd recipes! Using the same amount of protein but with more hearty ingredients like filling carbs and veggies added, you can satisfy extra hungry tummies or keep something for tomorrow’s lunch. If you’re on a 2-person plan, these recipes make 4 portions; on a 4-person plan, they make 8 portions.

steps.text: Prep veggies: Preheat the oven to 220C, fan-forced. Line a large oven tray with baking paper. Thickly slice the capsicums. Cut the zucchini into thirds, then cut into thick wedges. Crush or finely chop 2 garlic cloves. Drain and rinse the chickpeas.

Roast veggies: Put the capsicum, zucchini, chickpeas, half the garlic, 2 tsp Italian seasoning and 1 tbs olive oil in a large bowl, season with salt and pepper and toss to combine. Put on the lined tray, reserving the bowl. Roast for 25 mins or until tender.

Make dressing: Meanwhile, put the yoghurt, 1½ tsp red wine vinegar and 1½ tsp honey in a bowl, season with salt and pepper and stir to combine. Put the remaining garlic, remaining Italian seasoning and 1 tbs olive oil in a separate bowl, season with salt and pepper and stir to combine. Halve the olives.

Toast herb bread: Transfer the roasted veggie mixture to the reserved bowl. Reduce the oven to 180C. Halve the baguettes lengthwise (see Feed A Crowd) and put, cut-side up, on the oven tray. Brush with the garlic oil mixture, then bake for 8 mins or until lightly toasted.
Serve up: Divide the roasted veggie mixture among plates, scatter over the olives and drizzle with the yoghurt dressing. Serve with the herb bread and enjoy!
Feed A Crowd: Up the crunch factor and cut the baguettes into 2cm cubes instead. Toss in the garlic oil mixture and bake until golden and crisp. Scatter over the roasted veggies just before serving.
